payload.name: apply_patch
payload.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/divadbaroon/Desktop/IDETrace/scripts/datasheet_stats.py
+import pandas as pd
+
+e = pd.read_parquet("data/events.parquet")
+s = e.groupby("session_id").agg(student=("student_id", "first"), start=("ts", "min"), end=("ts", "max"), ai=("assistant_open", "any"))
+s["minutes"] = (s.end - s.start).dt.total_seconds() / 60
+types = e.type.value_counts()
+out = ["## Composition", "",
+       f"- **Students:** {e.student_id.nunique():,}",
+       f"- **Sessions:** {len(s):,} (median length {s.minutes.median():.0f} min)",
+       f"- **Total time:** {s.minutes.sum() / 60:,.0f} hours",
+       f"- **Events:** {len(e):,}",
+       f"- **Sessions with an AI assistant panel open at some point:** {s.ai.mean():.0%}", "",
+       "| event type | count | share |", "|---|---|---|"]
+out += [f"| {t} | {n:,} | {n / len(e):.1%} |" for t, n in types.items()]
+print("\n".join(out))
*** End Patch
